The '''Bootlegger's Slide''' was a [[Tube Complex]] obstacle used on a [[swoopchasing]] course. An open-air anti-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] channel, [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] experienced weightlessness during a turn. The anti-gravity propelled the swoops at speeds up to six hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], forcing the riders to rely on [[Maneuvering jet/Legends|maneuvering jets]].<ref name="BSS" />
